title: B5
query: Find all the proteins that are associated with the same pathways and conduct the same ions as the protein 'KCNG3'.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (target:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) MATCH (target)-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway) MATCH (target)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) WITH target, collect(DISTINCT p) AS targetPathways, collect(DISTINCT i) AS targetIons MATCH (protein:Protein) WHERE protein <> target MATCH (protein)-[:hasPathway]->(p2:Pathway) WHERE p2 IN targetPathways MATCH (protein)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i2:Ion) WHERE i2 IN targetIons RETURN DISTINCT protein.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (target:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) MATCH (target)-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway) WITH target, collect(DISTINCT p) AS targetPathways MATCH (target)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) WITH target, targetPathways, collect(DISTINCT i) AS targetIons MATCH (candidate:Protein) WHERE candidate <> target MATCH (candidate)-[:hasPathway]->(cp:Pathway) WITH target, targetPathways, targetIons, candidate, collect(DISTINCT cp) AS candidatePathways MATCH (candidate)-[:hasIonAsso]->(ci:Ion) WITH candidate, targetPathways, targetIons, candidatePathways, collect(DISTINCT ci) AS candidateIons WHERE ALL(p IN targetPathways WHERE p IN candidatePathways)   AND ALL(i IN targetIons WHERE i IN candidateIons) RETURN DISTINCT candidate.label AS protein, candidate.id AS proteinId ORDER BY protein;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (target:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) MATCH (target)-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway) MATCH (target)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) MATCH (other:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(p) MATCH (other)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i) WHERE other <> target RETURN DISTINCT other.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (target:Protein {label: 'KCNG3'}) MATCH (target)-[:hasPathway]->(p:Pathway) WITH target, collect(DISTINCT p) AS targetPathways MATCH (target)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i:Ion) WITH target, targetPathways, collect(DISTINCT i) AS targetIons MATCH (protein:Protein) WHERE protein <> target MATCH (protein)-[:hasPathway]->(p2:Pathway) WITH target, targetPathways, targetIons, protein, collect(DISTINCT p2) AS proteinPathways MATCH (protein)-[:hasIonAsso]->(i2:Ion) WITH protein, targetPathways, targetIons, proteinPathways, collect(DISTINCT i2) AS proteinIons WHERE ALL(p IN targetPathways WHERE p IN proteinPathways)   AND ALL(i IN targetIons WHERE i IN proteinIons) RETURN DISTINCT protein.label LIMIT 100

query: Which family and group does the ion channel 'HTR3E' belong to?

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (ic:LightIonChannel {label: 'HTR3E'})-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) MATCH (ic)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) RETURN DISTINCT f.label AS family, g.label AS group LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (ic:LightIonChannel {label: 'HTR3E'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (ic)-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) OPTIONAL MATCH (ic)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) RETURN ic.label AS ion_channel, f.label AS family, g.label AS group;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Protein {label: 'HTR3E'})-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) MATCH (p)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) RETURN DISTINCT f.label AS family, g.label AS group LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (ic:LightIonChannel {label: 'HTR3E'})-[:hasFamily]->(f:Family) MATCH (ic)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) RETURN DISTINCT f.label AS family, g.label AS group LIMIT 100

title: C2
query: Find all ion channels that are connected to the 'Neuronal System' pathway through interacting proteins.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (p:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(p) MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:interact]-(prot) RETURN DISTINCT lic.label UNION MATCH (p:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(p) MATCH (dic:DarkIonChannel)-[:interact]-(prot) RETURN DISTINCT dic.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (p:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(path:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (ic)-[:interact]-(p) WHERE ic:LightIonChannel OR ic:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT ic.id AS ion_channel_id, ic.label AS ion_channel_name
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (p:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (prot:Protein)-[:hasPathway]->(p) MATCH (ion)-[:interact]-(prot) WHERE ion:LightIonChannel OR ion:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT ion.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (p:Pathway {label: 'Neuronal System'}) MATCH (ip)-[:hasPathway]->(p) MATCH (ic)-[:interact]-(ip) WHERE ic:LightIonChannel OR ic:DarkIonChannel RETURN DISTINCT ic.label LIMIT 100

title: C3
query: List the light ion channels in the Chloride channels group and their respective functional domains.

ablation_results.with_instructions: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) MATCH (lic)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE g.label = 'Chloride channels' RETURN DISTINCT lic.label AS LightIonChannel, fd.label AS FunctionalDomain LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_instructions: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group {label: 'Chloride channels'}) OPTIONAL MATCH (lic)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) RETURN lic.label AS light_ion_channel, collect(DISTINCT fd.label) AS functional_domains ORDER BY light_ion_channel;
ablation_results.without_schema_comments: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) MATCH (lic)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE g.label = "Chloride channels" RETURN DISTINCT lic.label, fd.label LIMIT 100
ablation_results.without_relevant_nodes: MATCH (lic:LightIonChannel)-[:hasGroup]->(g:Group) MATCH (lic)-[:hasFunctionalDomain]->(fd:FunctionalDomain) WHERE g.label = 'Chloride channels' RETURN DISTINCT lic.label, fd.label LIMIT 100
